summary.en: The through-line of a run: one cell per unit, label and count at the left; cells shrink away as the run reduces the count, the bar lights for the result.
summary.zh: 运行的贯穿线索：一格一个单元，左边是标签和计数；运行减少计数时格子缩走，结果出来时整条亮起。

fits: A run that reduces a total: tokens, bytes, steps.
notFor: Totals that grow without bound; more than about 150 units.

intent.en: The total the run reduces is always visible, so every step's saving is felt.
intent.zh: 运行在减少的总数一直看得见，每一步省下多少都能感到。

content.en: The starting count and the current count (≤ 150 units); a label (≤ 10 / 4 字).
content.zh: 起始数与当前数（≤ 150 个单位）；标签（≤ 10 字符 / 4 字）。

fits.zh: 把总数往下减的运行：词元、字节、步数。

notFor.zh: 无限增长的总数；超过约 150 个单位。

pairs.note: grows its count into the result

en: Keep it at the same place all film; it is the through-line.
zh: 整片放在同一位置；它就是贯穿线索。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
